# Helium (`cogify.me/helium`) — Webpage Features Outline Data

## 1. Hero Section
- **Badge**: `macOS 15.4+ · Apple Notarized · Multi-Google-Drive Pool`
- **Headline**: `more space for your mac, without buying a new ssd.`
- **Subheadline**: `helium combines all your google drives into one native macos volume at /Volumes/Helium. open 50 gb video timelines and disk images in under a second while using 0 bytes on your internal ssd.`
- **Primary CTA**: `Download for Mac` (`Helium.dmg`)
- **Web App / URL**: `https://cogify.me/helium`

---

## 2. Editorial Numbered Outline (`01` – `04`)

### `[ 1 ]` what it is
- A native virtual drive in macOS Finder (`/Volumes/Helium`) powered by all your Google Drive accounts pooled together.
- Sits right beside `Macintosh HD` in Finder. Files show their real size and open natively in `QuickTime`, `Preview`, `Final Cut Pro`, `DaVinci Resolve`, or `DiskImageMounter`—while occupying **`0 KB on this Mac`**.

### `[ 2 ]` why we built it
- Traditional cloud sync apps mirror files onto your local SSD or force you to wait for full downloads before a file opens.
- Single free Google accounts cap out at 15 GB, leaving gigabytes stranded across multiple accounts.
- **Key Metrics**:
  - **`0 KB`** local SSD space used by unpinned cloud files
  - **`< 1 sec`** instant byte-range streaming for 4K video & large archives
  - **`N × Drives`** combined into a single unified macOS storage pool

### `[ 3 ]` how to start
- `01` Install **Helium** and link two or more Google Drive accounts from the menu bar.
- `02` Open **`/Volumes/Helium`** in macOS Finder.
- `03` Drag in your largest folders, video timelines, or `.dmg` archives—done.

### `[ 4 ]` what you get (12 Feature Bullets)
1. **Multi-Account Google Drive Pool** — Combine unlimited Google accounts into one unified Finder volume (`/Volumes/Helium`).
2. **64 MB RAID-0 Chunk Striping** — Store 50+ GB video masters across multiple 15 GB Google Drives automatically without hitting single-drive quota limits.
3. **Whole-File Smart Placement** — Automatically routes standard files to your highest-priority drive with available space so they remain directly viewable in Google Drive Web.
4. **Zero-Knowledge AES-256-GCM Encryption** — Lock files and chunks on your Mac using keys stored in macOS Keychain before a single byte uploads.
5. **0 KB Local Disk Footprint** — Uses APFS sparse file placeholders and on-demand byte streaming so terabytes of cloud files take `0 KB` on your MacBook SSD.
6. **Direct NLE Video Editing** — Edit 4K footage directly in DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, Premiere Pro, and CapCut without copying to local storage first.
7. **Menu Bar Quick Dropzone** — Drag files or folders straight onto the smiling Helium icon in your macOS menu bar for instant background offload.
8. **Offline Folder Pinning** — Pin critical project folders for flights and offline work; unpin in one click to reclaim local SSD space.
9. **Instant Global Spotlight (`⌃⌥O`)** — Search across every linked Google Drive account simultaneously in milliseconds.
10. **1-Click Share & File Request Links (`cogify.me/helium`)** — Right-click any file in Finder to copy a share link or collect client deliverables directly into your pool.
11. **Bi-Directional Sync & 30-Day Cloud Trash** — Deletions and uploads stay synced across Finder, the Helium app, and Google Drive with a 30-day recovery bin.
12. **Pool Rebalancer & SHA-256 Verifier** — Rebalance usage across drives or safely drain an account before unlinking without losing a single chunk.
